The WTA believes that breaking down barriers for women in sport and in health go hand in hand. That’s why the WTA Foundation is on a mission to close the global women’s health gap and created the Global Women's Health Fund, which supports UNICEF.
The WTA Foundation and former World No. 4 Anke Huber recently visited Tanzania with UNICEF, where they met with community health workers, nutrition experts and families to see firsthand how UNICEF's work brings essential health and nutrition resources directly into the hands of moms around the world.
